title: Schooling, symphony concerts and growing interest in music
summary: He says weekly school symphony concerts grew on him; he names his schools and that he is an only child of Mary and James.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: How did you get interested in music? Going to school,
I was going to school and
every Tuesday we had to go to concert, symphony concert. And well, it just sort of grew on me. And you go to a symphony concert? Yes, every Tuesday.
What was that? What school were you going to?
I was going to McDonald's 36th. And I went to Hoffman and then Booker T.
Booker T. Yeah, that's right uptown.
Well, it was no, it's on Roman Street.
Yeah, right up, right by AM on there.

Did you come from a large family? You had a brother and a sister? I'm the only child. What's your mother's name? Mary. Your father's name? James. So you would do a name after the father. Did he play music?
